instruction: List all my S3 bucket analytics configurations that export data to a bucket owned by a different AWS account.
expected_answer: One analytics configuration exports to a different account: 'testAnalyticsConfiguration' on {{serverless-apps-S3Storage-us-east-1-AnalyticsBucketName}}, whose S3BucketDestination sets BucketAccountId to 111122223333, which is not the account that owns the source bucket. It is the only such configuration.
